quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #11
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 18

questions.question: As alcohol builds up in your blood, it:

options.text: Slows down your reactions.
Makes you feel less confident.
Begins to metabolize itself more quickly.
Decreases the number of driving errors.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slows down your reactions.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your reactions, makes you feel more confident, and causes you to make more mistakes.

questions.question: What happens if you drink alcohol while taking prescription or over-the-counter medicine?

options.text: The medicine reduces the effect of the alcohol.
The alcohol will help the medicine cure a cold.
The combination could multiply the effects of the alcohol or medicine.
There is no effect because they are different substances.

questions.correctAnswerText: The combination could multiply the effects of the alcohol or medicine.
questions.explanation: Alcohol and other drugs together can increase the impairing effects of both. For example, one drink with a cold remedy could affect you like several drinks would on their own.

questions.question: On a two-lane street, a fire engine is following your vehicle but not using emergency signals. You should:

options.text: Continue to drive in a normal manner.
Stop as quickly as you can.
Speed up to get out of its way.
Slow down, move as far to the right as possible, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue to drive in a normal manner.
questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is following you without a siren or flashing lights, you do not need to move. Drive normally.

questions.question: You are driving when it starts to sleet or snow. You should:

options.text: Keep your windshield and mirrors clear.
Allow additional distance between your vehicle and the vehicles that you are following.
Approach all vehicles with caution.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: In snowy weather, keep your windshield and mirrors clear. Leave more space between your car and the car ahead because slippery roads need more distance to stop.

questions.question: When you see this sign, it means:

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the chevron points. In this case, the road curves to the left. You may see several chevron signs throughout the curve.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Intersection ahead.
Steep grade ahead.
Winding road.
Merging traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steep grade ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downhill grade ahead.

questions.question: You notice a vehicle defect that may affect safe operation. You should:

options.text: Correct the defect as soon as possible.
Correct the defect when you can afford it.
Drive the vehicle at slower speeds.
Drive normally.

questions.correctAnswerText: Correct the defect as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: Any defect that may affect safe operation must be fixed right away. Fix it before driving the vehicle.

questions.question: At dusk or on overcast days, you should:

options.text: Drive using your four-way flashers.
Drive using your parking lights.
Not turn on any vehicle lights.
Turn on your headlights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your headlights.
questions.explanation: At dusk or on overcast days, turn on your headlights. Use low beam within 1,000 feet of oncoming vehicles and within 500 feet of vehicles ahead of you. Always use low beams in poor weather.

questions.question: The amount of space you need to cross traffic depends on the:

options.text: Road conditions, weather conditions, and oncoming traffic.
Presence of a stop sign.
Use of your turn signals.
Cars behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road conditions, weather conditions, and oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: The space you need to cross traffic depends on road conditions, weather conditions, and oncoming traffic.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light at an intersection means you should:

options.text: Slow down and proceed with care.
Continue normally through the intersection.
Stop and proceed when a green light appears.
Stop and proceed when the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with care.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means caution. Slow down, look, and proceed carefully.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in busy areas and business districts if no sign says otherwise?

options.text: 10 mph
20 mph
30 mph
50 mph

questions.correctAnswerText: 30 mph
questions.explanation: The speed limit in busy areas and business districts is 30 mph unless a sign says otherwise. Drive slowly in these areas because many pedestrians may cross the road.

questions.question: What are highway signs called when they tell you about dangerous road conditions?

options.text: Regulatory signs
Warning signs
Information signs
Guide signs

questions.correctAnswerText: Warning signs
questions.explanation: Warning signs tell drivers about dangerous conditions ahead. Follow warning signs to stay safe. Ignoring them can cause accidents.

questions.question: What do pennant-shaped signs mean?

options.text: School zones
No passing zones
Speed limits
Railroad crossings

questions.correctAnswerText: No passing zones
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs mark no passing zones. The sign will have text to confirm it is a no passing area.

questions.question: What is your blind spot?

options.text: Areas you cannot see without turning your head
The area directly behind your vehicle
The area you see in your rearview mirror
The area you see in your side mirror

questions.correctAnswerText: Areas you cannot see without turning your head
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas you cannot see without turning your head. They are on the sides and behind your vehicle.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign
Watch for children and be ready to stop
Always honk your horn when you see children
Be ready to help children cross the street

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop
questions.explanation: You must let all pedestrians cross safely. Pay attention when driving through intersections or turning, especially near schools.

questions.question: You see a flashing red light at an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Stop completely, then go when it is safe
Stop only if other cars are also coming to the intersection
Stop only if other cars are already in the intersection
Slow down and stop only if needed

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. You must stop, let other drivers pass, and then go when it is safe.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means what color light will come next?

options.text: Flashing yellow
Steady green
Steady red
Flashing red

questions.correctAnswerText: Steady red
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a steady red light will come next.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a traffic signal mean?

options.text: It is only used on one-way streets
It means go, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points
It only works if there is also a circular green light
It points to an airport

questions.correctAnswerText: It means go, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go, but you must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does a steady yellow light at an intersection mean?

options.text: Go
Yield to other cars
Slow down and prepare to stop
Stop

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and prepare to stop
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a red light is coming soon. Slow down and get ready to stop. If you are already in the intersection or cannot stop safely, continue through carefully.

questions.question: What do crossbuck signs indicate?

options.text: Railroad crossings
School zones
No passing zones
Hospitals

questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad crossings
questions.explanation: Crossbuck signs show railroad crossings. Let trains pass before crossing. Never try to drive faster than a train.

questions.question: What should you do if traffic signals are not working due to a power outage?

options.text: Park your vehicle off the road and wait for power to return.
Use hand signals to show other drivers what you plan to do.
Turn on your hazard lights and drive through without stopping.
Treat the intersection like a four-way stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat the intersection like a four-way stop.
questions.explanation: When traffic lights are not working, treat the intersection as a four-way stop. Take turns with other drivers. When it is your turn, go through carefully.

questions.question: At a light rail intersection, you should always:

options.text: Look both ways before crossing the tracks.
Pay attention and follow all traffic signals.
Share the road with pedestrians and bicyclists.
All of these.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of these.
questions.explanation: Never drive around lowered crossing gates. Always look both ways before crossing train tracks. Always obey signs and traffic signals. Trains share the road with cars and bicyclists.

questions.question: Work zone signs mean:

options.text: It is summer.
You must stop right away and back up.
Driving conditions are not ideal.
You should drive faster to leave the work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Driving conditions are not ideal.
questions.explanation: Work zone signs are orange. They warn you that work is happening on or next to the road. Drive carefully when you see these signs.

questions.question: If you are driving slowly and traffic is backing up behind you, what should you do?

options.text: Drive even slower.
Pull off to the right side of the road and let traffic pass.
Do not let other cars pass you.
Turn on your four-way flashers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off to the right side of the road and let traffic pass.
questions.explanation: Driving much slower than other traffic is unsafe. On a two-lane road, if traffic backs up behind you, you must pull off the road and let other vehicles pass. Only drive under the speed limit when road conditions require it.

questions.question: What does a single dashed yellow line in the center of the road mean?

options.text: Drivers may pass if it is safe.
Both lanes travel in the same direction.
Drivers may not pass.
Drivers may pass even if it is dangerous.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers may pass if it is safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A single dashed yellow line means cars in both directions can pass. You may only pass if it is safe and will not interfere with oncoming traffic.
